missionStatus.title: Mission Status
missionStatus.description: The current production pipeline's status, per the most recent Mission Control update.
missionStatus.emptyDetail: Available once the full production pipeline (agx run) executes.

financialCoverage.title: Financial Data Coverage
financialCoverage.description: Coverage requires at least one real reported financial item for every universe ticker; missing depth remains visible.

collectors.title: Collectors
collectors.description: Output of each source's most recent collection run.

sourceHealth.title: Source Health
sourceHealth.subtitle: Rollup across the full source registry -- see Research → Source Intelligence for per-source detail

currentBlockers.title: Current Blockers
currentBlockers.emptyDetail: The most recent execution reported no errors or warnings.

acquisitionDecisions.title: Acquisition Decisions
acquisitionDecisions.description: Every capability's ranked acquisition strategies this run -- which source was selected, and why every other candidate was skipped, failed, or produced nothing usable. A capability is never tied to one website: this is the runtime Acquisition Decision Engine's own record of the fallback chain it evaluated.

weeklyDiscovery.title: Weekly Discovery
weeklyDiscovery.description: The Acquisition Intelligence Engine's own scheduled, evidenced attempt to verify a real endpoint for every catalogued PLANNED/CANDIDATE source (see .github/workflows/discovery.yml) -- never an automatic promotion, always a human-reviewed pull request.
weeklyDiscovery.emptyDetail: Published once the weekly workflow's pull request merges -- see docs/DATA_ACQUISITION.md's Discovery workflow section.

runtime.title: Runtime & Versions
runtime.description: The pipeline version and mode behind the most recent execution.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.subtitle: Where this run's artifacts were written, and which stages were skipped
configuration.noSkippedStages: No stages were skipped in the most recent run.

replay.title: Replay
replay.detail: Replay mode re-executes the identical pipeline against already-archived RawDocuments from a prior run, proving the pipeline cannot distinguish live data from replayed data. No dedicated replay-history artifact exists separately from Execution History below.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.description: Every dashboard artifact file written by the most recent run, and how many records it holds.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Every stage of the most recent execution, slowest first.

pipelineHealth.title: Pipeline Health
pipelineHealth.description: Every stage of the most recent execution, in order.

executionHistory.title: Execution History
executionHistory.description: Every research-cycle run recorded, including research outcomes, error, and session detail.

logs.title: Logs
logs.detail: No artifact carries raw log lines yet -- this section will populate once one exists, rather than fabricating a log stream.
